_comment: Orphan requirement citations. Entries may shrink, never grow. See the module docstring in check_req_citations.py. 2026-09-28 (#211/QA-A-149): lowered 21->14 ids, 79->58 citations. The lane checked each row of the lead's mapping table against the pre-deletion spec (d6bde7d) rather than applying it, and three rows were wrong -- 059 and 063 name different requirements than the table claimed, 025 is retired rather than absorbed. It also refused a mechanical range substitution: old 011 was an underflow clamp, current 011 is Gain Correction Execution, so 009..011 -> 010..011 would have pointed an offset comment at a gain requirement while this check stayed green. P1A 066 stays: orphaned all along, surfaced by the #213 definition-scope fix; restore-or-retire is #211's call.
